Introduction

ALPHA DRIVE ONE, also shortened as ALD1, is an upcoming eight-member boy group formed through the survival show Boys II Planet.

The group consists of the top eight contestants Lee Sangwon, Zhou Anxin, He Xinlong, Kim Geonwoo, Zhang Jiahao, Lee Leo, Chung Sanghyeon, and Kim Junseo.
